I replied in the thread. You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant were showing a white screen after badge scan.

While they were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers by hand on a clipboard. The channel shows nothing else from the guard until 11:03 AM. Mateo posted then that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836 on it. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes had been working since 11:07.

Those times are as they appear in the channel. The channel doesn't state a time zone.
